change_summary: Replace the drill guide with an explicit Garden zero-independent-approval test policy using current-head proof, trusted CI and exact task association.

task_examples.title: Correct the local PostgreSQL port-conflict instructions
task_examples.content: At Garden dev 458833c297382e679a9de3c4539b3c51239aac0d, README still suggests changing only DATABASE_URL if host port 55432 is occupied. Align it with docs/guides/develop/fix-setup-problems.md: change the compose.dev.yaml host mapping and DATABASE_URL together, keep container port 5432 distinct, and link the detailed instructions. Do not change runtime configuration or delete data volumes. Start from and target dev; run the applicable documentation checks.

task_examples.title: Document the Garden Workstream contribution handoff
task_examples.content: Add a concise contributor page for the approved Workstream project: claim, task trailer before final checks and any required review, actual current-head GitHub checks, proof.json ZIP and PRE/POST feedback. Explain the explicit Garden test approval count of zero and the omitted default of one. Link it from CONTRIBUTING without replacing ordinary contributions. Use placeholders, no credentials; start from and target dev.
